name: Pure Silver Core: Madness
descriptionTemplate: At battle start, {Rouse} all Awakeners, draw {Twilight: Utopian Veil} into hand, increase the team's Hand Limit by +2, and increase the Keyflare storage limit by +100%. After releasing the Posse, all Awakeners' Crit. DMG and Temporary Crit. Rate +[Arg1]%, receive Shield equal to 20% of their Max HP, and draw cards until the Hand Limit is reached.
